comment: R3D-SURFACES floor tags and patch rules (docs/systems/SURFACES_CATALOG.md section 3). A floor material declares `tags` (ASSETS/materials/<id>/<id>.json) out of this vocabulary; a patch kind lists what the floor under it must have (`requires`: ALL of these) and must not have (`forbids`: ANY of these). Unknown tags and a kind with art but no rule here are loud errors.
